title: Codex add project smoke contract
summary: Use Codex to add a manifest-driven smoke-check contract artifact for projects, with focused docs and tests, without performing any live deployment or health check action.

actions.prompt: Add a small manifest-driven smoke-check contract path for Cortex project manifests. Prefer extending existing manifest tooling so validated manifests can render a deterministic planning-only smoke-check artifact or stdout for the first project deployment. The output should describe what runtime services, routes, dependencies, and operator-visible checks should be verified after a deployment, but it must remain documentation/planning only. Keep scope tight: do not modify bootstrap/compose/edge/*, do not run live health checks, do not change .codex/config.toml, and keep the output as planning/documentation only. Add focused docs/tests and run targeted validation/tests afterward.
